comment: Screenshot spec for Vice Cover Studio. Each shot names a real state of the app (see app/src/shots.js VCS_SHOT_STATES, same order) and how it is captured: 'export' shots save the app's own rendered cover at the export size, downscaled to the competition limits; the 'editor' shot is a browser screenshot of the studio with a photo loaded. Final files are JPEG, long side at most 1280 px, short side at least 480 px, at most 262144 bytes, finished with the house unsharp pass (GaussianBlur sigma 3.0, addWeighted k = 1.5).

shots.state: vice-quad layout, vice-sunset grade, all four bundled samples across the panels, stacked caption VICE HEAT with subtitle accent
